Spring fair

The spring fair is on the green, from ten until four. Entry is free; bring a bag for the plant stall.

Getting there, with the map

Take the 12 bus to the church.
Walk past the hall
and the fair is on your left.

  • Stalls
    1. Plants
    2. Books, second hand
  • Music
    • The brass band at noon
  • Food

Last year we raised enough for the roof.

  • Thank you to every stall holder
